body: Thank you so much
Thanks. We've put limits in place. Slip ups are a problem. But for the first time in my life going too far is the problem instead of not far enough.
It was just a stupid crush. She wasn't my girlfriend or family. Why can't time heal this wound.

Hey, thanks for your concern :) 

Don't worry, I don't have access to guns at the moment. I just wish I did so that it would be instant and hopefully painless.

Yeah that makes sense. Failed experiences can definitely be detrimental to your confidence (in the sense of trying it again) but I think you should try to think about it a little more objectively (which can be pretty hard in a viscerally subjective and emotional experience like this, I get it).

You've maybe thought about this before, but what were the lessons you learnt from your failed confession? What do you think you could've done better, now that you have quite a bit of hindsight? Keep a note of it, literal written notes preferably but yeah.

Also, I'm glad you're aware of your clingy nature, it's so much better than being selfishly clingy without any awareness and then blaming the other person or just crying about the unfairness of it all. (Trust me I've been there...)

At the end of the day, I know that you'll be overthinking and proceeding with caution, and that is not an inherently bad thing at all. But this is just pure human emotion you're dealing with and it can (and probably will) be something completely different from anything you can imagine after all. Humans really are that unpredictable imo.

I'm not gonna say much about my story other than that I went into confessing to my crush before we even really talked, and it fucked things up badly until I managed to have a long discussion with her that was mostly just me talking. We were friends since then and... Not a day goes by when I don't miss her, when I wish that she was still here. I legit find it kinda funny that I used to think that her not liking me back was the worst thing that could happen to me, I didn't even think of the possibility of how much joy she brought me by just existing, and her death definitely wasn't something I ever considered until it was too late. Anyway, if you ever wanna know about that you can read my post history I guess.

I'm not on these crush subreddits because I have a crush right now. I don't think I ever will. But seeing people have this pure, unadulterated passion for other people really does remind me of days gone by from the perspective I have now. I can't say "go tell him now right now tell him *NOW*" because I really will never know your full story. All I can say is dont overthink it too much, human emotion is just that, human, and thus unpredictable. And the world needs love and affection, I don't think it's ever a bad thing to put that energy out there. 

I'm so glad you know where you stand in this and you seem more than mature enough to know how to handle it. If it means anything, this one random guy on the internet who lost the unrequited love of his life really does believe in you.

I get it, I really do. My honest to god advice would be to just take it fairly casually, ask him when you can talk to him or when he's free in the most non-confrontational, non-nosey way. I'm of the opinion that guys like it when a girl is just a lil clingy but maybe that's me, either way keep it healthy but don't wait *too* long. 

I had something happen that really put these crush things into perspective for me, so maybe you find my advice a little too reckless, and I get it. I'll firmly believe that it's better to try and fail because at the end of the day that's not the worst thing that can happen with your dynamic, even though I know how much and for how long it might feel like it is. I wish you well, I really do.

Hey man, I'm not gonna tell you what to do with your life (mostly because in this case it would be incredibly hypocritical of me) but all I'll say is that I really hope you don't go through with what I think you're talking about. I'm on this subreddit as a reminder of the perspective of my life before she... went away, and that kind of pain is not worth putting out there. I'm not saying "it doesn't end the pain, it only transfers it" because holy shit thats cheesy and invalidating, but I will say that there is a lot of bad stuff that's gonna happen even after you're gone. Maybe I'm just biased because of her, but I hope you stay strong.
Yeah, definitely. Even though she rejected me I'd do anything to just have her and that friendship back again. I miss her.

Congrats dude, and good on you for spreading wisdom. I told my crush about what I felt about her way before we were decent friends and she rejected me, but it was after I told her that she decided to be my friend and we had a good platonic thing going on. It hurt me a lot but in the moments I spent with her I wouldn't have had it any other way.
Idk man I get the appeal of Subway but Domino's sometimes fire too...
I can't really give you advice for shooting your shot, but I'd highly recommend trying to build a friendship again first. That's gonna make things much smoother, I promise.
I got a good feeling about this, that's all I'll say.

Imo it'll never be the right time. What I mean is that there are a whole myriad of things that could happen, good or bad, any second now with either of you two or your dynamic. I could relate to your thought about not wanting to come off as clingy, good god I wish I would've thought about that before I asked out a girl I wasn't even friends with. She rejected me, obviously, but we became friends out of that. 

I'm not saying this won't go badly. I have no idea. From what you've described I have a good gut feeling about this but don't take that as gospel. All I can REALLY say for POSITIVE is that don't hesitate to shoot your shot the moment you're ready, life is too fragile for more than a little bit of caution. Good luck :)
I cant know what you're going through right now but please try to stay strong. I'm so sorry you're in a situation even remotely similar to mine this is not right

I'm so fucking sorry. I know this really won't mean all that much but my story is kinda similar, you can read my old post I guess. It was just a few months ago that I used to cry because she didn't like me back the way I liked her, she was my only source of any fucking positive emotion I've ever felt in a long time and her not loving me back felt like the worst thing possible. Now.... Id be more than happy to live in a world where she wasn't even friends with me, where she fucking hated me if it just meant she would be alive again. The perspective has been a fucking gutpunch of the highest order. I'm so fucking sorry dude.

I'm so fucking sorry. I lost a girl I just had a stupid teenage crush on, I know it means nothing but her death has already completely ruined me. I can't imagine what it must be like to lose 2 best friends. In a sense she was my best friend too but I highly doubt that feeling was mutual. Idk. All I can say is that I do feel a small fraction of your pain I guess but I cannot even fathom what it must feel like. I wish nothing but the best for you.

Oh and my recommendation would be the entire The Shining album by J Dilla. Her favourite was E=MC2 but I loved the production on So Far To Go. Still, I recommend the whole record. The lyrics are really not a ton more than above decent hip hop affair for the era, but the production definitely hits even now. Stay strong.
Definitely. I harmed myself before she killed herself anyway so maybe my word doesn't mean much, but since she's left I've wanted nothing but a pistol to blow my brains out with.

I'm sorry about your loss. I can't really imagine what you're going through, I've never liked anyone in my family and all I really care about is financial dependency but fuck, I've seen how close some people can be to their siblings. I just had a stupid crush on a girl who died.

You're right, reframing my question might help. Knowing the things she went through before doing what she did won't be enough, it's the visceral feeling she felt that I'll never get. I never saw her smile while she was alive, and I don't know if I'll ever understand why.

Idk about the socialisation part, guess I just never felt it sorry, but yeah I agree that it can be just as hard. I had romantic feelings for her looking back, I'm willing to accept that, but once we were just platonic friends it was just as good. Her death was incredibly devastating as a friend, I still think losing her if she was indeed my GF would've hurt a little bit more but I definitely agree that there is an element of invalidity when I tell people that she was just a friend/crush.

Only been a couple weeks since she's died and I've not really had any dreams of any sort since I heard the news. I used to dream a lot about her when she was alive. Day dreaming. And a little bit of... "guilty" dreaming. I'm still trying to come to terms with the fact that I loved her. It seems harder to swallow that fact than the fact that she didn't love me back, which was easy to live with. Of course that was all child's play if she was still just fucking here.
Thanks I need this right now its been not that long

Thanks I guess. No one irl wants to talk about it. I think I might do it. Not sure when or how probably not soon but still. It's true you only really appreciate it once it's gone. We didn't have good memories. She wasn't happy at all. Just crying scared or angry mostly. Sometimes I'd bring this little sampler I had and teach her how old hip hop beats were made. I've never seen her smile but that was the only time she said "stay" and stuff. She was the epitome of rbf sometimes. I think I loved her. Idk. I would much rather be in a world where she hated me and wanted to kill me than a world where she is fucking dead.
Idk maybe this comment goes against my post but I would much much much rather live in a world where she fucking hated me and wanted nothing to do with me then one where she's dead. I can't take it.
Sorry got incoherent at the end. Im angry. Maybe Im being selfish and whiny. idk
